## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The only correction in the reviewed scope is optional: remove the ineffective legacy-header test, since the complete-report test already covers version rejection.

## Changes

The parser now requires the exact header `REPORT v1`. The pull request adds two tests intended to check rejection of unsupported versions.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

(none)

## Suggestions

- tests/test_report.py:11 — tests — Remove the ineffective legacy-header test — For `REPORT v1\nversion=v1`, the test changes the payload to `version=v0` and leaves the header at `REPORT v1`. The fixture lacks `END`, so the parser returns `None` before checking the header. — The test would still pass if the parser accepted legacy headers.
